finding: Windows calls SHGetKnownFolderPath; APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA environment overrides do not establish managed state ownership.
decision: Do not execute on the local Windows user profile. Qualify on a clean GitHub-hosted Windows runner only after refusing existing Yazi roots, acquiring an explicit owned lease, resetting actual state between executions and confirming process/path cleanup.
